title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision
abstract: arXiv:2610.37905v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public disclosure repositories such as SEC EDGAR support informed investment through web access to corporate filings. Supporting their review with language model agents requires discovering unstated deficiencies across related documents, acquiring missing company facts, and verifying that requested revisions satisfy evidence-backed requirements. Existing financial question-answering evaluations provide limited evidence of these interactive capabilities. We introduce \textbf{FilingLoop}, an interactive benchmark and a self-evolving agent framework for corporate disclosure review and revision. Grounded in historical U.S.\ Securities and Exchange Commission correspondence, FilingLoop reconstructs 380 predominantly IPO review tasks from 96 companies under distinct information constraints. translated_title: FilingLoop：用于公司信息披露审查与修订的大语言模型智能体评估与进化
translated_abstract: 诸如SEC EDGAR之类的公开信息披露存储库通过网页访问公司申报文件来支持知情投资决策。利用语言模型智能体辅助此类审查工作，需要能够在相关文件中发现未明确指出的缺陷、获取缺失的公司事实，并验证所要求的修订满足有证据支撑的要求。然而，现有的金融问答类评估对这类交互能力的检验十分有限。我们提出了FilingLoop——一个面向公司信息披露审查与修订的交互式基准测试和自进化智能体框架。该框架以美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的历史审查往来函件为基础，在 distinct 的信息约束条件下，从96家公司中重建了380个以IPO审查为主的任务。一个独立于执行智能体的评估器依据6,099项合格要求对最终申报文件和回复进行评分，并审计缺乏依据的声明及有害
tldr: 提出了FilingLoop——一个基于SEC历史审查函件构建的交互式基准与自进化智能体框架，用于评估并持续进化大语言模型智能体在公司信息披露审查与修订任务中的能力。
en_tdlr: FilingLoop, an interactive benchmark and self-evolving agent framework grounded in historical SEC review correspondence, evaluates and evolves LLM agents for corporate disclosure review and revision tasks.
